findings.A5_problem: The V5 artifact ownership matrix disagrees with worker and stage contracts. W01, W02 and W04 outputs lack formal ownership rows; W12 lists D1_K_CRITERIA_REGISTER while S9 is the stated freeze owner; W11 lists canonical hard-gate artifacts while S16 is their stated owner; and KILL_CRITERION_CHANGE_RECORD.jsonl has no ownership row.
findings.exact_required_change: Define one canonical ownership precedence, derive a complete ownership graph from V6 worker/stage contracts, use one primary writer per execution artifact, remove W12/S9 and W11/S16 conflicts, and add ownership QA that returns zero conflicts and verifies all W01-W12.
findings.V6_resolution: Created a contract-derived V6 ownership graph with creation stage, primary owner, writer, handoff, readers, update permission and contract references. S9 owns frozen K criteria; S16 owns canonical hard-gate and package artifacts; W11/W12 contracts now emit only their own artifacts. All worker output artifacts have one owner and ownership QA passes.
findings.verification_rule: Every execution artifact has exactly one canonical owner/writer; worker and stage references agree; ownership_conflicts==0; W01-W12 ownership verified==12/12.
findings.residual_risk: Future execution must preserve the same single-writer rule when new artifacts are introduced.

findings.A5_problem: HG-11 routed worker-output failure generically to S16 package readiness, without identifying the originating worker or reconciliation stage that can repair the failed content.
findings.exact_required_change: Create per-worker failure routes with failure class, failed artifact, return worker/stage, reconciliation stage, responsible owner, required correction, artifact update, re-entry gate, retry policy and human-review condition; cross-check every route against hard gates.
findings.V6_resolution: Created a worker failure routing matrix covering W01-W12 and all required failure classes, added failure_routes and reentry fields to every V6 worker contract, and created worker-to-hard-gate routing QA. No worker-specific route is an unqualified S16-only route.
findings.verification_rule: Each worker has valid failure routes; invalid generic S16-only routes==0; routing mismatches==0; route target and re-entry gate are valid.
findings.residual_risk: S16 remains available for genuine package-level failures only; worker-content failures must use the worker-specific matrix.
